column1: # Callers of the ordered-container (red-black tree) runtime - the enumeration OC-4 asked for
# Derived from the shipping EXE, authority hash
# included, by disassembling every body in work/graph/functions.tsv and recording every direct
# call or jmp whose target is one of the six members.
# 99 distinct callers. 170 distinct (caller, callee) PAIRS - the page's "170 call edges" - across
# 213 CALL SITES, because a caller that inserts twice in two branches is one pair and two sites.
# The two numbers are both right and they are not the same number; this file carries sites.
# 0016DA60 is in this list. It is a family MEMBER calling the two rotations, which is the family's
# only internal edge, and it is one of the 99 the page counts.
# member_signature  which of the six this caller uses. Six signatures occur and NO CALLER USES MORE
#                   THAN TWO MEMBERS: inc+era 30, dec+ins 24, inc+ins 16, ins 16, inc 12, and
#                   rotL+rotR 1 (which is 0016DA60, the erase, i.e. the family's own internal edge).
# node_size         the size passed to the allocator immediately before an insert, where the caller
#                   allocates. Nine values, every one 0x20 + a multiple of 8; see OC-2.
# name              EVERY ONE OF THE 99 IS FUN_xxxxxxxx. Not one caller of this family is named.
# NOT IN THIS FILE: what any caller means. The signature and the node size are structural facts
# taken from the instructions; no caller was read for purpose, and the subsystem attribution in
# section 5 of the page comes from audit_crossrefs rather than from here.
